_comment: CTR-TOK-24 size gate (scripts/size_gate.py). Contracts allowed over their limit, with the measured runtime size they may not exceed; `<name>.init` likewise for init code over EIP-3860. Owner 2026-10-11: size optimised later (Glamsterdam); remove an entry once the contract fits. UA-4: + the UA ledger. UA-5a: + the receivers (wrapToUA, unwrapToUA, mintToUA, payWithFeeToUA), the UA allowlist, uaPayReceiverFee. UA-5b: + UATradeOrder (uaTrade, uaCancelOrder, uaInvalidateNonces, views) and uaWrap. P6g: + the `_batchable` / `_uaEnvelopeBinding` hooks (+137 B on each token), the PQZ kinds `NoUnderlyingPqzToken` / `UnderlyingPqzToken` (deployed on chain 7622: `maxCodeSize` 65,536 from block 0, init 131,072). UA index (owner 2026-10-17): `UARegistry` 25,602 B (the per-kind list: uaCount / uaAt / uaPage / uaIndex); the PQZ kinds +26 B (the Record's `index` field in their recordOf decoding). UA secp256k1: `UARegistry` 25,861 B. P6g op 7 (2026-10-17): the PQZ kinds shrink (statement views by DELEGATECALL into `PqzLib`, now 19,921 B) despite the op 7 entries; every token +14–33 B (`multiLegFee` in the unused-field check). Review W-Q (2026-10-19): every token +1.5–1.9 KB (`nonReentrant` on the pay, mint, role, owner and rate entries, CTR-MTX-18); `UARegistry` −5 B (W-M).
